reason: PURE. The "Every batch lab-tested" line and the QR code on the box caught my eye first, and sachets are easy to toss in a travel bag. I would scan the QR before checking out, and if the report is real and the lab is named, I would try one box.
objection: Zero reviews, and an ISO 17025 lab report is not the same as NSF or USP certification. I only trust the QR report if the lab is real and the batch number on my box matches it.
would_change_my_mind: A QR report that opens to a real, named lab with the actual batch number and results, or an NSF or USP mark. Some verified reviews would help too.
